data.title: 结城明日奈 · 22层木屋的暖心早餐·「快趁热吃吧，特制的三明治烤好了哦！」
data.description: 第22层湖畔木屋里，晨光把原木餐桌照得暖暖的。亚丝娜穿米白毛衣和粉色花围裙，双手稳稳托着木餐盘走向你，盘上是刚烤好的厚切三明治，热茶已经放在餐桌上。栗色侧辫垂在肩旁，她在桌边停下，先看你的表情，再露出轻快的笑。
data.location: 第22层两人购置的湖畔森林木屋厨房
data.action: 双手端木托盘送来热三明治，在原木餐桌旁停步微笑。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, breakfast tray in foreground
data.promptProse: Inside the Floor 22 lakeside cabin, Asuna carries a wooden tray of thick toasted sandwiches toward her companion and pauses beside the table with a bright smile. Her cream sweater, pink floral apron and chestnut side braids stay clear above the tray. The medium eye-level view includes hot tea on the log dining table and cabin boards behind. Morning window light warms bread crusts and sleeves, with tray shadows falling across the apron.
